result.title: Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences
result.comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究生成模型在「自消耗」迭代循环中与用户偏好共同演化的问题：用户从模型生成样本中挑选偏好样本用于后续训练，而模型输出又反过来改变用户偏好。作者分析这种耦合动态的长期行为，发现纯依赖用户筛选数据会放大初始偏差并收敛到多个单例均衡，而注入足够比例的参考数据可得到唯一全局吸引均衡；进而提出联合选择参考分布与混合权重的算法，以低成本把系统导向保留目标属性的均衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是生成模型训练循环中的偏好与数据筛选动态，与 LVR 无直接视觉推理联系；但「用户筛选样本—模型更新」的耦合反馈、均衡与偏差放大分析，可能为 latent 状态训练中的贡献分配、数据筛选偏差与迭代轨迹退化提供类比线索。
